purpose: 为 AISpace 内容提供分类优先、日期其次的私有/公共归档路径，并区分生命周期与外部权威。

routing.sharedReviewEvidence: ES/UIEvidence or the owning test/evidence directory; Public stores an index only
routing.unityImportedReference: Assets/UI/References or another existing Unity-owned asset directory
routing.unityTestCapture: Assets/ESTestAssets/**/Screenshots or the owning test fixture output directory

assetRule: Assets/Screenshots is not the default MCP or AI temporary screenshot root; keep an existing Asset path only when Unity import/reference or a test fixture requires it.
authorityBoundary: This policy classifies placement only; it does not authorize deletion, renaming, Git, Unity, Runtime, network, release, or publication.
retention: Temporary content is disposable; stable/archived content is retained by category/date. Cleanup requires a separate explicit user instruction.
